name: Anthropic (Claude)
description: Anthropic Claude chat-completion provider — Opus, Sonnet, Haiku across the 4.x family. Claims the 'claude' model prefix (e.g. 'claude-haiku-4-5'). Owns the @anthropic-ai/sdk dependency: it lives in this plugin's package.json, NOT core's, so Spore Core has zero vendor SDK deps when no provider plugins are installed. Supports both standard API keys and OAuth (sk-ant-oat-…) tokens for Claude.ai-issued Pro / Max creator credentials.
